one_line_description.value: Plaid provides developer APIs for financial data; its Auth product retrieves bank account information for ACH, wire, and other bank-to-bank transfers.
one_line_description.quote: Retrieve bank account information for ACH, wire, and other bank-to-bank transfers.

has_public_api.quote: To gain access to the Plaid API, create an account on the Plaid Dashboard.

api_type.quote: The Plaid API is specified in our Plaid OpenAPI GitHub repo.

api_breadth.value: Broad multi-product REST API: endpoints span Auth, Balance, Identity, Transactions, Investments, Liabilities, Assets, Income, Statements, Transfer, and more; read-write, and the Postman collection covers almost all endpoints.
api_breadth.quote: The Postman collection provides pre-formatted requests for almost all of Plaid's API endpoints.

docs_url.quote: Here you'll find guides, resources, and references to build with Plaid.

auth_methods.quote: `client_credentials` allows exchanging a client id and client secret for a refresh and access token.

oauth_scopes_documented.quote: A space-separated list of scopes associated with this token, in the format described in https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6749#section-3.3.

access_model.quote: These models only apply to Production traffic; usage of Sandbox is always free.

access_notes.value: Sandbox is free and self-serve via a Dashboard account. Production API access must be requested via the Dashboard. Free Trial plans (new US/Canada teams) allow 10 Production Items, after which a paid plan is required; EU/UK businesses or those serving EU/UK end users can only use Custom plans.
access_notes.quote: After creating 10 Items in Production, you must upgrade to a paid plan to create more Production Items.

official_mcp_server.quote: The Dashboard MCP server is available at `https://api.dashboard.plaid.com/mcp/` and uses the Streamable HTTP protocol.

rate_limits.value: Per-endpoint limits documented; /accounts/balance/get: 5 per minute and 30 per hour in Sandbox, 1,200 per minute in Production.
rate_limits.quote: | /accounts/balance/get | 5 per minute, 30 per hour | 1,200 per minute |

webhooks.quote: A webhook is an HTTP request used to provide push notifications. Plaid sends webhooks to programmatically inform you about changes to Plaid Items or the status of asynchronous processes.

sandbox_or_test_env.quote: Plaid has two environments: Sandbox and Production.

verdict_reason: Plaid documents a broad REST API with client_id/secret and OAuth 2.0 credentials, plus a free Sandbox that is accessible via a Dashboard account. Production access must be requested and is limited on the free Trial to 10 Production Items before a paid plan is needed. Because the documented developer route is self-serve and free for Sandbox, the app is easy to build against, though production rollout has billing and approval gates.
main_blocker: Production approval and paid plan after free Trial limit
open_questions: Official SDK languages were not listed in the supplied evidence; the client libraries page (https://plaid.com/docs/api/libraries/) was not fetched.
API versioning and deprecation/sunset policy were not present in the supplied evidence; the versioning page (https://plaid.com/docs/api/versioning/) was not fetched.
No community or third-party MCP servers were found in the evidence; absence is not confirmed.
Plaid documents both https://api.dashboard.plaid.com/mcp/ in current docs and https://api.dashboard.plaid.com/mcp/sse in a 2025 blog post; the current docs URL was used.
Whether Production access approval is an app-review process versus plan/billing approval is not fully specified in the supplied evidence.
